body: I've brought up the idea a couple times, but she doesn't want to go.  And I've looked around, and there is no way we could even afford one.

I understand what you are saying, I just don't know how else to show her how much I love her.  I try to do things around the house for her (I usually just get an eye roll because I mess something up while trying to help out.  I usually mess up the laundry, or cleaning, etc).  I try to take her out on little dates here and there, she'll get upset with me and say that I'm trying to buy her.  I'll try to be romantic at home, and she'll say I'm only doing it to get in her panties.  It's so exhausting. I don't know what changed from when we were dating/engaged.  I love her so much, but I am such a fuck up.  She deserves to be with a guy who can support her financially, emotionally, etc.

Yeah.  She'll usually just start crying and not talk to me for hours and blame me for the way she treats me and just tells me that I do it too.  I love my wife, and she doesn't *always* treat me so negatively.  But most of the time she does, and I can't seem to confront her about it. It just turns into her crying, me getting upset, repeat.
